name: B10-0223/2026 (Renew) – New Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the new Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion. It condemns a new Chinese law on "ethnic unity and progress", which it says pushes assimilation and restricts the cultural, religious and linguistic freedoms of Tibetans, Uyghurs, Mongolians, Hui and Manchus. It asks China to repeal the law, asks the European Union to consider sanctions on officials behind it, and asks European Union countries to suspend extradition treaties with China.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks for action; it cannot make China or European Union governments act.
- **Who it affects:** China's ethnic and religious minorities, and European Union countries deciding on sanctions and extradition.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to European Union institutions, member states, China's government and the United Nations human rights chief.
